messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — AtlasOps QBR is scheduled for Tue 10am PT. Need final deck by Friday EOD. Can everyone confirm slide ownership and any blockers?
Darren Li: I can own account health + renewal-risk slide. Will pull last 90d usage + ARR motion.
Samir Khan: I'll take onboarding status + enablement gaps. Need the latest CSAT and onboarding completion rates (user vs org levels).
Olivia Park: Dashboard link is here: https://dash.internal/redwood/atlasops — I'll export the adoption + latency graphs and drop them into the slides.
Mia Chen: Perfect. @Darren include the churn-risk flags and two proposed mitigations (short term + exec ask). Call out the KYC delay and integration mapping as primary risks. :warning:
Darren Li: Will add a 1-slide mitigation runbook with owners and ETA. Tentative owners: Product (Riley), Integration Eng (Marco), CS (Samir).
Samir Khan: For enablement, I want to highlight a product walkthrough + playbook for their onboarding PMs. Need a quote from product on feature X timeline. @Olivia can you ping Riley?
Olivia Park: Pinged @Riley this morning — Riley replied: "Feature X on track for EoQ; small API tweak still under review." I'll paste Riley's note in the slide notes.
Riley Gomez: Quick confirm — ETA is end of Q. We can offer a partial workaround (manual mapping) that should reduce lift by ~60% for their integration. Happy to be listed as owner for exec ask.
Mia Chen: Great, add that as an ask: "Request dedicated eng hours to finalize API tweak" with expected MVE and upside. We should keep the ask one clear sentence for execs.
Darren Li: Action items (I'll update our action board):
- Darren: Health + Risk slide (due Thu noon)
- Samir: Onboarding + Enablement playbook slide (due Thu EOD)
- Olivia: Graph exports + paste Riley note (due Wed)
- Riley: Short bullet on workaround + ETA (due Wed)
Mia Chen: Also capture feedback themes from the last EBR — can we include 2 anonymized quotes (positive + constructive)? Samir, do you have those?
Samir Khan: Yes — pulling quotes now. Will anonymize and add 2 bullets under "Voice of Customer."
CS Bot: Reminder: QBR deck for channel #customer-success (AtlasOps) is due by 2026-03-20 17:00 PT. Please update the shared slide: https://slides.internal/atlasops-qbr
Olivia Park: I'm adding a short troubleshooting checklist on the ops page for the integration team (1 slide). That should reduce post-QBR spike in action items.
Mia Chen: Last ask — keep deck to 8 slides max and include an "Ask" slide with 3 bullets (people, time, budget). I'll do the exec summary.
Darren Li: Noted. I'll trim the health metrics to top-3 KPIs.
Samir Khan: Once slides are in, can we do a 30-min run-through Mon morning? Preferably 9am PT.
Mia Chen: Let's tentatively book Mon 9am PT. If anything shifts, call it out here. Thanks everyone — this is looking good. :raised_hands:
